{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_values = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].unique()
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline:", sentinel_values)

# Check for missing values
missing_baseline = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].isnull().sum()
print("Missing values in biomarker_baseline:", missing_baseline)

# Check the distribution of severity
severity_dist = trial_df['severity'].value_counts()
print("Severity distribution:\n", severity_dist)

# Identify rows where biomarker_baseline is -999.0
negative_nine_ninety_nine = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]
print("Number of rows with biomarker_baseline = -999.0:", len(negative_nine_ninety_nine))

# Display the first few of these rows
negative_nine_ninety_nine.head()"}
